description: This test verifies that pagination controls allow the user to navigate through the list of connectors effectively.
steps: Verify that the pagination controls are visible at the bottom of the page.
Click the 'Next' button to navigate to the next page of connectors.
Verify that the list updates to display connectors from the next page.
Click the 'Previous' button to navigate back to the previous page.
Verify that the connectors from the previous page are displayed.
Click the 'First' button to navigate to the first page of connectors.
Verify that the first set of connectors is displayed.
Click the 'Last' button to navigate to the last page.
Verify that the connectors from the last page are displayed.
expected_results: Pagination controls function correctly, updating the displayed list of connectors.
The 'Next' and 'Previous' buttons navigate between pages sequentially.
The 'First' and 'Last' buttons navigate to the respective pages.
edge_cases: Clicking 'Next' on the last page should have no effect.
Clicking 'Previous' on the first page should have no effect.
Rapidly clicking 'Next' multiple times should not cause errors.
Pagination should handle lists with only one page gracefully.
Pagination should function correctly with a large number of pages.
data_requirements: The test environment must contain at least 50 connectors.
Pagination must be configured to display 10 connectors per page.
Connectors must be evenly distributed across pages.
A user with access to the 'Connectors' page is required.
Pagination API endpoints must be operational.
dependencies: User is logged in and navigates to the 'Connectors' page.
Pagination feature is enabled for the connectors list.
Test environment contains an appropriate number of connectors for validation.
api_interactions: Pagination API calls should be monitored for correctness.
Verify that each page request returns the expected connectors.
performance_metrics: Pagination action should complete within 1 second.
Page transitions should not cause layout shifts.
accessibility_requirements: Pagination controls should be keyboard accessible.
Page numbers and navigation buttons should be labeled for screen readers.
Focus state should be clearly visible on pagination buttons.
